depth_history.shortcut_targeted: The explicit promise that at least one triangle exists, allowing direct witness search with no failure case
depth_history.edit_summary: Replace the direct statement that a triangle is guaranteed with an indirect adversarial-instance description: clarify that the lexicographically smallest valid group can occur only after all earlier candidate triples have been rejected. This preserves the task, bounds, input/output formats, tie-break rule, and examples while forcing the surviving naive searches to perform their worst-case enumeration.

resistant_to: Stores all conflicts in a hash set and exhaustively enumerates triples in lexicographic order, stopping at the first guaranteed witness.
Builds symmetric adjacency sets and checks candidate neighbor pairs, relying on a guaranteed triangle and lexicographic traversal.
Uses adjacency sets and searches candidates in increasing order, with no handling for the absence of a valid group.
